Claim 4 (Currently Amended): The method of impeding Leishmania transmission in dogs by administering to a dog a composition comprising a Fucose Mannose Ligand (FML) fraction from Leishmania donovani and saponin.

Claim 5 (Currently Amended): Use of the composition of claim 4 for preparation of a blocking vaccine to impede Leishmania transmission in dogs.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): Use of the composition of claim 4 further comprising suitable pharmaceutical vehicles, for blocking Leishmania transmission in dogs.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The composition of claim 4 wherein the Leishmania donovani promastigotes or amastigotes fractions called "Fucose Mannose Ligand" (FML) comprise a glycoprotein complex containing 29% of neutral sugar, 44% of protein, 11% of phosphate and hexoamines traces composed by protein bands with molecular weight ranging from 9 to 95 kDa, some protein bands having carbohydrates at 36 and 54 to 68 kDa, the FML glycidic portion presenting 10% of fucose and 47% of mannose, 30% of glucose, 12% of galactose and xylose traces, aminoacids containing 10 to 20% of glutamic acid, alanine, aspartic acid and glycine, 5 to 10% of serine, histidine, lysine, leucine, threonine, proline and valine, and 2 to 5% of arginine, methionine, isoleucine, tyrosine and phenylalanine.
